Subject: Growth Engineer, and Agent Hub
Body:
Dear Joe,

Agent Hub in June put 30+ agents on one data layer. The Founding Growth Engineer posting reads like the GTM side of that same problem: pipelines and enrichment feeding decisions that have to be right.

That is what I build. B2Lead is a lead generation platform I have running in production, and at ReInvest Wealth I built the eval system that took our AI receipt matching to 97% accuracy.

I am short of the 5 years you ask for, graduating May 2027. Worth 15 minutes anyway?

Subject: Product Engineer, and Altitude's payout rails
Body:
Hello,

The Product Engineer posting is written about Altitude, so that is what I read: a USD and EUR business account paying out to 100+ countries with no US entity needed.

The money movement half I have built. NeoBank runs on Stripe Treasury and Issuing, Plaid ACH, and Stripe Identity for KYC. At WebFlux I ran real time integrations against Kalshi and Polymarket order books.

No Solana or Rust yet. The rest is TypeScript and Postgres, which is your stack.

Is the role open to a May 2027 graduate?

Subject: Direct Interac participation, and a 2027 grad
Body:
Dear Jean,

Becoming a direct Interac e-Transfer participant in July is the part I keep thinking about. Owning the rail instead of renting it changes what you can build on top of it.

I am Ottawa based, Carleton CS, graduating May 2027. Node, TypeScript and Postgres daily. At WebFlux I built a prop firm dashboard solo with real time Kalshi and Polymarket order book integrations, including drawdown and risk metrics, which is not far from what BLOC needs.

Senior is a stretch for me today. Would you consider a 2027 new grad?

Subject: Arc, and the 2027 new grad cycle
Body:
Hello,

The 2026 backend new grad posting is gone from your careers site, so this is a note for the next cycle rather than an application.

Arc going live last week with USDC as the gas token is why I am writing. Deterministic sub second finality is the kind of constraint I like working under. At Fincnx I built real time portfolio tracking for 500+ concurrent users at sub 100ms on WebSocket and Redis.

Carleton, BCS May 2027, Canadian. Could you keep me on the list for the 2027 cohort?

Subject: Solutions Engineer, and Parsed Streams
Body:
Dear Mert,

Parsed Streams pushing decoded transactions over WebSocket the moment they confirm is the part I would want to work on. I have built the consumer side of that shape: at Fincnx, real time portfolio tracking for 500+ concurrent users at sub 100ms over WebSocket and Redis, and at WebFlux, live integrations against Kalshi and Polymarket order books.

The Solutions Engineer posting asks for 1 to 2 years, which is actually where I am. Carleton CS, graduating May 2027, another Ontario kid.

Can I send you a resume?

Subject: The backend role, from someone who parsed the other end
Body:
Dear Zeno,

I built the email forwarding ingestion at ReInvest Wealth, so I have been on the receiving end of a production email pipeline: parsing what arrives, matching it, and owning it when it goes wrong. It gave me a lot of respect for what Resend hides.

I saw the backend engineer role go up last week. I work in TypeScript and Next.js daily, and I built the eval system that took our receipt matching to 97% accuracy.

Carleton CS, May 2027. Too early for you?

Subject: The Analytics Engineer role, and the dbt gap
Body:
Hello,

Seeing "KOHO Bank (letters patent pending)" inside your own job postings is a good detail. Becoming a Schedule I bank changes what the data underneath has to withstand.

I will be straight about the Analytics Engineer posting: I have not used dbt. What I do have is the adjacent half. At WebFlux I built the evaluation engine computing trader performance, drawdown and risk metrics, and at ReInvest Wealth I built the eval system that took AI receipt matching to 97%.

Carleton CS, May 2027, Canadian. Is there a junior version of this role?

Subject: Integrations role, or the Solutions Engineer one
Body:
Hello,

Shipping an MCP server that connects the platform to Claude is a more interesting detail than the awards, and it is what made me look closer.

The Integrations posting asks for 5+ years and Airflow, neither of which I have. But at Fincnx I was sole developer on a finance platform serving 1,500+ users and built algorithmic trading prototypes for Bank of Montreal, National Bank and Investment Planning Council Canada, which is the buyer you sell to.

Carleton CS, May 2027. Is the Solutions Engineer role a better fit for me?

Subject: Technical Support Analyst, and the Fiserv payfac launch
Body:
Hello,

Becoming a payments facilitator through Fiserv in February finished off the card side of the stack. One API across Interac, EFT, ACH, RTP and cards is a genuinely hard thing to have built.

I have built a small version of it. NeoBank runs Plaid ACH, Stripe Treasury and Issuing, and Stripe Identity for KYC. At Fincnx I was sole developer on a finance platform serving 1,500+ users, which meant I owned the failed transactions and the API errors.

The 1 to 3 year band fits me. Can I send a resume?

Subject: Developer Support Engineer, from one of your users
Body:
Hello,

The MCP server you shipped last week is a neat way to hand market data to an assistant with no API key to lose.

I have spent two years on the other side of this product category. At Tradeful I built a backtesting engine simulating strategies over 5+ years of historical market data at sub 500ms. At Fincnx I ran real time portfolio tracking for 500+ concurrent users at sub 100ms over WebSocket and Redis. I have hit the failure modes your support queue sees.

I am Canadian. Is the role open to me?

Subject: The QuickBooks API work, and a developer application
Body:
Hello,

Shipping direct API connectivity for QuickBooks, Xero and Wave in February, instead of scraping, is why I am writing. I know from the other side why that mattered.

I work at ReInvest Wealth, Canadian bookkeeping software, where I built the AI receipt ingestion and rebuilt the transactions interface. Bank feeds breaking reconciliation is a problem I have handled from the accounting end.

I am in Ottawa and would move to Toronto for the right role. Carleton CS, May 2027.

Should I send the resume and short doc your process asks for?

Subject: Cortex team, evaluations, and a 2027 grad
Body:
Hello,

The Senior Software Engineer posting for the Cortex team asks for grounding quality, citations, and evaluations that make AI output auditable. That is the specific thing I have already done.

At ReInvest Wealth I built the eval system that took an OpenAI vision receipt pipeline to 97% matching accuracy. CRO AI Audit is a retrieval platform I built on FastAPI, ChromaDB and GPT-4.

I am a new grad in May 2027, so I am under your senior bar and I know it.

Is there a level where that experience is still useful?
